Causal attribution to the deterministic ordinal selector specifically is not isolated from co-occurring process changes (independent verifiers, REGIME_STABLE_LOSS verdict repair, a populated frontier); no controlled counterfactual exists.

task_rank orders by agent-assigned qualitative labels (expected_information_gain, downstream_leverage, falsification_power, verifiability, effort, complexity, execution_risk); these labels are not calibrated or measured, so 'highest-value' means highest-labeled.
observed_effect: Frontier-first selection produced a clean, non-repeating ordering (MA crossover -> short-horizon reversal -> cross-sectional relative strength -> volatility targeting -> momentum -> longer-horizon momentum -> 20-day breakout -> cross-sectional momentum) in which each cell was closed once, decisively, and with independent verification, and no equivalent re-test was queued; the prior opportunistic period shows concrete inefficiencies (blocked execution 37261348530, run #40 persistence/rebase failure, queue-driven objective 37260572520).
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection improves information flow relative to opportunistic queue choice, and whether the controller's deterministic ordinal selector (as opposed to the broader frontier-first practice) is the operative cause.
uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: durable evidence shows the frontier-first selection practice is associated with improved information flow (decisive, non-duplicated, independently verified cell closures) relative to the prior opportunistic period. Not resolved: the selector's isolated causal magnitude, because the improvement is confounded with co-occurring process changes and only one selection exists in this campaign.
research_result: No market/research hypothesis was tested (LEARNING_PROCESS audit). Process finding: explicit frontier-first selection is associated with a clean, non-repeating sequence of decisively closed, independently verified frontier cells, whereas the prior opportunistic period shows blocked and queue-driven activations; the deterministic selector's isolated causal contribution is not established.
next: Execute P-002: audit resolved frontier cells against task history for duplicate or near-duplicate work to confirm the selector's resolved-cell exclusion prevents equivalent re-tests.
